caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden chest with a flat lid and a base featuring two drawers. The chest is decorated with intricate, symmetrical patterns and motifs on its front and side panels. The surface of the chest is primarily dark, with detailed designs in shades of red, gold, green, white, and orange. The central part of the front panel includes three stylized tree or floral forms, each flanked by a pair of standing lions arranged symmetrically and facing one another. Above and around these central motifs are various stylized tulip-like and heart-shaped flowers, as well as smaller abstract decorations. A geometric border runs along the top and bottom edges of the decorated panel. The drawers at the bottom are painted dark, likely black or a deep blue-green, with simple brass or gold-colored pulls; the central drawer features a circular, multicolored motif. The side panels display a geometric pattern with triangular sections of green, gold, and possibly red. The lower part of the chest rests on short bracket feet, and the artist’s signature, "Frances Lichten," appears on the lower left corner of the paper background. The entire chest sits against a plain, light tan or cream background.
title: Pa. German Painted Chest
